video-page.name: embed
video-page.title: Embed block required
video-page.description: A video page must contain at least one Embed block to host its video.
video-page.hint: Add an Embed block and give it the video URL (YouTube, Vimeo, or a fragment path).

campaign-page.name: embed
campaign-page.title: Exactly one Embed block required
campaign-page.description: A campaign page must contain exactly one Embed block.
campaign-page.hint: Add an Embed block, or remove the extras so only a single Embed remains.

print-page.name: embed
print-page.title: Embed block not supported
print-page.description: Embedded media does not render on a print page and will be dropped.
print-page.hint: Remove the Embed block, or switch the page to a template that supports media.
